svg.title: Mac — Audio
svg.desc: Original static settings design. Synthetic labels and source-default previews only; no runtime queries, audio, configuration writes or app behavior.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Choose a preferred microphone and use the operating system for output routing.
Effective state not queried. Proposed controls require supported host capabilities.
Inspection does not activate audio. Active route is distinct from your preference.
Uses the existing native input-preference selector; no invented device list.
Explicit retry keeps the saved preference and waits for observed route success.
Default off. HFP can switch AirPods to lower-fidelity mono call audio.
This device · Owner · Now / next activation
No hardware query ran for this frame. Display the route the OS actually reports.
On Mac opens Sound settings; iPhone/iPad use the system route affordance.
Explicit silence to the host while speaking; route-specific guards may still mask.
Advanced · turn taking and route checks
Default −35 · allowed −60…−15 dBFS. Any sustained sound can take the turn.
Default 0.3 · allowed 0.05–2 s. This is not a speaker-recognition control.
Default 1.5 · allowed 0.1–10 s. Does not replace a running pause timer.
Configure / Record are separate deliberate actions. Never run on page entry.
Device route choices stay separate from the host recognizer and private-coaching evidence.
Continue in All settings for every field, source and prerequisite. This frame shows representative controls.
